1. DESCRIPTION OF PROPOSED ACTION
1.3 LAND REQUIREMENTS
Page 1-4
The proposed project would require approximately 824 acres of land not 761 acres as stated in the first sentence. This correction should be made throughout the DES, as revised by Amendment 2, (Exhibit W, Section 3.0).
Section 1.3 has been revised.
Page 1-5
Paragraph four mentions in the first and last sentences, that a picnic area would be constructed at the Lower Whitewater Falls. Duke's original proposal for a picnic area to accommodate visitors at the Lower Whitewater Falls was dependent on Oconee County government participation in the maintenance and operation of the area. The county withdrew its offer to participate in the area's development and operation; therefore, Duke is withdrawing its offer to construct the picnic facility. All references to this picnic area in the DES should be removed.
Reference to a picnic area has been deleted.
The last paragraph states that "468 acres would be permanently occupied by the upper reservoir and other project facilities". This should be changed to "only 529 acres will be permanently removed from productivity". Change "293 acres" to "295 acres". These changes are part of Amendment 2, (Exhibit M, Section 3.0) and should be made throughout the DES.
Section 1.3 has been revised.
1.4.4 TRANSMISSION FACILITIES
Page 1-16
Change "525/13.8 KV" to "525/20.0 KV" as revised by Amendment 2 (Exhibit M, page 3).
Section 1.4.4 has been revised.
1.5 CONSTRUCTION PROCEDURES
Page 1-19
Reword the first paragraph to read:
"Improvements to the existing access road to the pilot tunnel portal area will begin in August 1976, with the excavation of the pilot tunnel and exploratory borings therein commencing in October 1976. Major construction activities will begin with the construction of the permanent access road, 75 months prior to the commercial operation of Units 1 and 2, assuming the pilot tunnel 1s completed prior to start. Clearing at the dam site will commence 18 months after the beginning of the major construction activities." Revise the remainder of Section 1.5 to orm to the revised construction schedule (See Exhibit W., Figure 1.5-1, Amendment 2).
Section 1.5 has been revised.
